title: A personal Spotlight can show what the Member gives back, as pills they choose (Spotlight split, SPL-05)

source.ref: Owner picks 2026-10-28: free value first, contributions on the free personal Spotlight

detail: Adds the member-only memberContributions block (What I give back): quiet stat pills for the Crew badge (real membership_tier), events hosted, Journeys finished and Zaps. The member chooses each pill with a switch (Crew and Zaps on, the others off); a zero never renders; every value is resolved server side, with one count-only helper (two head counts, no rows) added to the Spotlight reader. Never payments, amounts or who tipped.

verify.note: Fails on main (no memberContributions block); passes here.
